positive_control_meanings: Original untouched evidence independently audits successfully.
A persistent separate copy with fabricated controller summary yields exactly the same audited result.
Original evidence independently reaudits to the identical result after every negative mutation.

limits.comparison: Sequential writes use 32 calls; same-library concurrency uses 64 writes in one database, multi-library concurrency uses 16 in each of four databases; object sizes and S3 amplification differ.
limits.latency: Request latency includes service queue, response decoding and observer persistence; generator queue latency is reported separately.
limits.memory_discrepancy: The independent audit preserves sampled procfs values, decreases if observed, and owned wait4 separately; neither is a proved hard process limit.
limits.quantiles: Nearest rank, all offered outcomes included; p99 equals the maximum in these 32/64-call samples.
limits.resource_scope: scapd procfs samples and owned wait4 are separate observations; Node/Python/proxy/backend memory and host page cache are not counted as daemon RSS.
limits.sampling: RSS/FD/thread/disk samples can miss transients; nonzero collection time and actual maximum sample gaps are preserved.
limits.scope: One fixed local instrumented run through the unchanged release daemon and SDK, with a signed S3-compatible endpoint.

verification.verification: Every logical archive identity, regular content SHA256 and prior hardlink target was checked using a disk-backed inventory. No prior actual gate was rerun.

result.contract: HEAD7 terminal storage retirement native HTTP signed S3 bounded actual

terminal_retirement.later_multigeneration_contract: The separate GC contract above is now complete; the earlier terminal summary preserves its original then-pending boundary.

preserved_failures.cause: Exec ownership disappeared before completion; the original gzip was independently incomplete. Cause is undetermined. The distinct second archive was produced and every logical file verified without rerunning actual histories.

remote_ci.local_merge_basis: Existing repository maintainer authorization after all required local gates

not_certified: Real AWS Standard or S3 Express conditional-operation/IAM/KMS contract
Real NFS/EFS/FUSE mounts or production deployment failure domains
Production performance/cost/RPO/RTO SLO or long-running overload
HEAD8 or any later production source, automatic owner controller, explicit snapshots/PITR
Lazy cold loading, group commit or parallel writers inside one database
Hard RSS/disk isolation or a mathematical resource peak from periodic samples
Permanent emptiness of a retired namespace after one finite sweep
